summary: Quiet kerb beside bush, with a vacant lot opposite and homes 15 m away.

best_section.where: Dell Road kerb past the vacant lot, with bush opposite

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings mapped 15 m away at 55 and 67 m along; bush on the far side, empty lot beside.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street; narrow grassy verge, a few cars parked at the lower end.
drivers.convention: A few cars park here, no campers; signs restrict only weekday 9am-5pm.

flags: Home 7 m away at 89 m, so stop short of that
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy from the bush side, shade through the morning and midday.
